mission: Re-converge A1-A19 evidence on exact current main, allow only integrated-tree capability promotion, and keep branch-only evidence out of canonical maturity.

snapshot.note: R2 supersedes the stale A20 snapshot. A6 was merged into main before A20 #612, while other RC4 workers continued to advance on unmerged branches. Canonical maturity may change only when the capability implementation/evidence is integrated into this convergence tree.

maturity_changes.reason: A6 is merged into current main and exact cross-device browser evidence closes the responsive-PWA RC blocker without claiming offline or production Hardened evidence.

lanes.reason: Backend IAM evidence is green. A6 now closes generic responsive browser evidence, but A1 still lacks the complete MFA enrollment/recovery/session-inventory/revoke browser slice and provider/privacy lifecycle depth required for further promotion.
Remote Cloudflare observation remains unverified; provider recovery, restore/PITR, replication and production-state claims still lack direct environment evidence.

Durable migration runtime and retry evidence are green, but the implementation is not integrated into the R2 tree and restore/PITR/cutover, opening-data reconciliation and applied-state evidence remain dependencies.

A19 still reproduces the VN statutory App Registry method-contract failure on this head. A9 now supplies a green GL aggregate seam on its own branch, but A4 has not consumed it in an integrated candidate.
A19 independently passes the current A5 code slice, but clause-complete BHXH/BHYT/BHTN numeric authority remains open and the branch is not integrated into current main.

A6 is merged on main. Exact run 30871503111 passed demo build, 50 current-V2 browser checks, runtime build and 19 runtime/login/PWA checks; only docs/workflow cleanup changed after the validated source head. This closes U01-001 Responsive PWA from Wired to RC while leaving installability/offline/device/production claims conservative.

A7 repaired its earlier failures and exact final validation is green, but the backend/schema branch is still unmerged. R2 records B01-005/B01-009/B01-010 as evidence candidates only; no branch-only promotion enters main.

Typed provider/DLQ seams and isolated strict tests exist and A19 independently passes the lane, but physical quarantine/replay, credential lifecycle and real provider evidence remain outside the unmerged branch.
Authoritative read-only GL aggregate boundary is exact-head green and independently replayed by A19, but it is not integrated into current main and does not by itself close A4 Finance capabilities.
A19 reports the Customer 360 regression file fails to parse near line 292. Authored CRM source therefore remains non-acceptance evidence until a new immutable green head exists.
Supplier cancellation/permission hardening is green and independently replayed, but the branch is unmerged and does not prove whole supplier-governance or landed-cost capability depth.

Scanner/WMS and valuation-focused gates are green and A19 independently passes the lane, but the backend branch is unmerged; source-targeted landed-cost valuation and cross-owner GL propagation remain open.
The URL-constructor test defect was fixed at 5c9c47b, but exact RC4 A13 validation still fails on lane-owned TypeScript/QMS issues according to A19. No maturity promotion is accepted.
A19 independently passes the current Project/Service/Field lane, but the business-rule/metadata branch remains unmerged and durable SLA/finance/row-policy/channel/offline dependencies remain.
A19 independently passes the semantic/AI lane, but dashboard/recommendation implementation is still branch-only and UI/provider productization dependencies remain.
Workplace reminder/expiry regressions are exact-head green and independently replayed, but the branch is unmerged and shared maintenance scheduling/provider wiring remains outside the candidate.
A19 independently passes route authorization for the current branch, but it remains unmerged and POS payment, stock reservation/return and dedicated device/offline dependencies remain.

Golden Order exact-release verification logic has local 12/12 evidence and A19 independently passes the lane, but authenticated live Golden Order/current production evidence is absent and the branch is unmerged.

A19 now has reviewable A1-A18 heads and reports 13 independent PASS, A6 deferred, with A4/A7/A10/A13 blocked in its snapshot. A7 subsequently produced a new own-lane green head, so A19 is useful cross-lane evidence but is stale for A7 and its overall run still fails.
